_comment: What Intermarché Drive Méré actually lists for every product the app can put in a basket, read off intermarche.com in Charlotte's logged-in Chrome. Keyed by the name the recipes, staples and equivalents use. The site's own title, pack and price often differ from the receipt, and receipt names are poor search terms, so the basket step works from "url" — the product's page, one per barcode — and falls back to "search", a term checked to return the product. status: exact = the same product and pack as the name; check = the nearest listing differs (renamed, a different pack) and needs Charlotte's OK before it goes in; picked = a guessed ingredient resolved to a real listing; missing = nothing suitable, see alternatives. "available": false means out of stock on the day it was checked — stock changes daily, so the basket step still checks live. Regenerate stale entries with npm run catalogue:queue and a browsing session; hand-correct freely.
